children: Oasis Management Company Ltd. disclosed a 6.2% stake in Vail Resorts, Inc. and moved to engage the company’s strategy and governance. The Schedule 13D was filed on Sep. 16, 2026, after Oasis nominated four directors for election at the 2026 annual meeting. The activist step signals a campaign focused on operations, pricing, and guest experience at the mountain resort operator.

Oasis nominated Robert Chapek, M. Ashton Hudson, Bryce Roberts, and Picabo Street for the board and will fund the proxy effort. The fund says a refreshed board can sharpen focus on guest experience, pricing, marketing, and better use of hospitality assets, arguing Vail’s 42 premier resorts are not fully reflected in the stock. “A reconstituted Board, bringing fresh perspective and relevant operating experience, would be well positioned to work with management,” Oasis wrote.

The group also wants more accessible entry points to the sport, improved operations, stronger food and beverage, deeper ties with host communities, and more year-round programming. Oasis agreed to pay standard nomination fees to three nominees and entered a separate agreement with Chapek that includes $100,000 per month for consulting and a $500,000 forgivable loan if he joins the board, stating it aims to “deepen the connection” with guests and communities.

Oasis Management Company Ltd. is a Cayman Islands-based investment manager founded by Seth Fischer and operates from Hong Kong, overseeing private investment funds. The firm is known for shareholder activism and value-driven, event-focused investing, particularly across Asia and developed markets. Fischer supervises all investment activities and has led campaigns that push for operational improvements and governance changes.
